# kayjs-ui

> Components for kay apps, shipped as `.kay` sources the app compiles as its own and styled by the classes of one `theme.css` the app restyles: buttons, forms and inputs, dialogs, tables, navigation, layouts, charts, drag and drop, media and more.

Setup: `ui()` runs with no argument and takes none; the settings an app replaces go in a module named by `librarySettings` in `kay.config.ts`.

## Topics

`bunx kay docs <words>` prints the section of these files or kay's that matches.

The rest by topic, each file read whole with one command:

- [Setup, settings and testing](llms/setup.md): installing the theme and components, the settings that map icons, testing an app that uses it
- [Restyle a component](llms/restyle.md): `class` as a string or an object of parts, `src/ui.ts`, the parts of every component, the contract every component keeps
- [toast and Toaster](llms/toasts.md): toast, toast.promise, toast.update, onDismiss, attempt, messageOf, Toaster position, limit and the toast block
- [Icons, buttons, dialogs, cards, popovers and stats](llms/basics.md): Icon, Button, Dialog, ConfirmDelete, Card, Badge, Notice, Avatar, AvatarGroup, Popover, HoverCard, TooltipHost, Tooltip, RelativeTime, Stat, Meter, BarList, CopyButton, Rating
- [Inputs, selects, editors and forms](llms/forms.md): TextInput, Textarea, Select, DateInput, DateRangeInput, DateTimeInput, TimeInput, RadioGroup, RowsField, MarkdownEditor, and the onInput and onChange convention
- [Sliders, pickers, file drops and menus](llms/pickers.md): RangeInput, Slider, ColorInput, MultiSelect, Combobox, FileDrop, Menu, IconPicker
- [MarkdownEditor](llms/markdown-editor.md): the markdown textarea with shortcuts, toolbar, preview and image upload
- [Forms, FormDialog and Steps](llms/forms-and-steps.md): FormField, Form, SaveForm, ContactForm, SubscribeForm, FormDialog, Steps, RecordButton
- [Table](llms/table.md): Table columns, sort, filter, selection, export, virtual rows, footer, column toggle, caption and scroll region
- [Tabs, navigation and pagination](llms/tables-navigation-and-layout.md): Segmented, Tabs, TabNav, SiteNav, SideNav, AppHeader, AppSwitcher, Toggle, Checkbox, Pagination, QrCode
- [Blocks, links and parts of the components](llms/slots-and-links.md): the `@title`, `@heading`, `@tab`, `@link`, `@slide` and `@caption` blocks, `href` on Card, CardRow, Avatar, Badge and Timeline, icons, badges, nesting and dismissal in navigation and Notice
- [Page layout, command palette and trees](llms/page-layout-palette-and-trees.md): PageHeader, PageSection, CollapsibleSection, Accordion, Widget, CardRow, SidePanel, Toolbar, SplitLayout, NavigationProgress, CommandPalette, TreeView, Timeline, DescriptionList, Bell
- [Open state, transitions and data sources](llms/open-state-and-sources.md): onOpenChange and value on CollapsibleSection and Accordion, TreeView lazy children, callbacks on Avatar, CopyButton, AudioPlayer and Pagination, async items and options, `list` on collection components, `@option` on choice controls
- [Texts and languages](llms/words.md): the `ui.*` messages that word every default text, and the page's locale in charts
- [Infinite lists, LoadMore and a Table over them](llms/infinite-list.md): infiniteList, LoadMore, patching a loaded row, an action as the source, the server filter and sort of a Table(list), async rows, busy and row links on Table and VirtualList
- [Charts and MapView](llms/charts.md): LineChart, BarChart, ScatterChart, MapView, ContributionGraph, Sparkline, StatusStrip
- [Drag and drop, galleries and image tools](llms/charts-drag-and-media.md): Sortable, Board, DropTargets, MediaGallery, Carousel, AudioPlayer, Masonry, WhenVisible, VirtualList, ZoomPane, ImageCropper

## A `style` on a root

A component's root writes its own declarations first and an app's `style` after them, as an app's `class` wins the class merge: ZoomPane, Masonry, SplitLayout, Popover, HoverCard, QrCode and Skeleton all do. A declaration the component computes to work (ZoomPane's `touch-action`, a Popover's `position-anchor`, a Skeleton's `--_skeleton-width`, a QrCode's `width`) is overridden the same way, so an app that sets one owns the result.
